The table groups monthly figures under merged quarter headers, which can be difficult to preserve when converting to Markdown.

| Region | Q1 |  |  | Q2 |  |  |

|  | Jan | Feb | Mar | Apr | May | Jun |
| Midwest | $118k | $121k | $127k | $130k | $126k | $134k |","issues":[{"severity":"high","description":"The table separator/alignment row is malformed: it contains more cells than the header row and includes empty alignment cells (`| | |`), which makes the Markdown table invalid or inconsistently rendered."},{"severity":"high","description":"The second header row is missing the leading empty placeholder cell needed to represent the row-spanned 'Region' header, causing the month labels to shift left under the wrong columns."},{"severity":"medium","description":"Currency values were unnecessarily escaped as `\$118k` etc. The intended content is plain `$118k`; while often rendered similarly, this is not faithful Markdown output."},{"severity":"medium","description":"Merged header structure is not cleanly preserved in valid GFM. Since Markdown cannot truly merge cells, the converter should approximate it with a consistent 7-column table using blank placeholder cells rather than producing broken syntax."}]}
